title: Hyderabad: 17-year-old driver kills 55-year-old, crashes into 8 vehicles
content: A 55-year-old man died and another person was injured after a car crashed into multiple vehicles. The accident occurred on Sunday morning under Madhuranagar Police Station limits in Hyderabad. A 17-year-old boy was allegedly driving the car which first hit a two-wheeler. Seven other vehicles were also damaged in the collision which was captured on CCTV. The minor driver has been taken into custody by the police.

title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
content: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax. He suggested that aggressive tax increases could negatively impact tourism and competitiveness. Bezos also criticized targeting individuals, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation. Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

title: Bullion market: What will guide gold, silver prices this week?
content: Gold and silver prices are expected to trade within a narrow range this week. Investors await key US economic data, especially non-farm payrolls, for Fed policy direction. Purchasing managers' index data from major economies will also be closely monitored. Developments concerning the US-Iran conflict and crude oil supplies will influence sentiment. Analysts anticipate gold to trade between Rs 1.40-1.44 lakh per 10 grams.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: Virginia students rescue three family members from Lake Culpeper
content: Three Culpeper teenagers are heroes after rescuing a family whose kayaks overturned. They heard a splash and a child screaming, then immediately acted. The teens swam to the struggling family and brought them safely back to shore. Police and school officials praised their quick thinking and courage. Their actions highlight the importance of immediate response in water emergencies.

title: World’s first motel site in California listed for sale after 101 years
content: The iconic site of the world's first motel in San Luis Obispo is now on the market. With various redevelopment options available, buyers are encouraged to re-envision this historic property. Established in 1925 and ceasing operations in 1991, this site presents a unique opportunity to either preserve or transform a piece of hospitality history amidst the recent trend of revitalizing classic motels into boutique experiences.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leaked on X, reaches 5.9M accounts before removal
content: A high-quality bootleg of Spider-Man: Brand New Day ran on X for around seven hours on Friday, reaching 5.9 million accounts and drawing over 143,000 likes before Sony had it pulled. It follows a full leak of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey eight days earlier. Neither dented the numbers: Tom Holland's Spider-Man took roughly $168 million on opening day, beating Avengers: Endgame's 2019 record.

title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid
content: In Gujarat, registered construction workers have the opportunity to benefit from financial support aimed at housing through the Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana. To qualify, applicants must have been registered with the welfare board for a minimum of two years. Following the acquisition of an e-Nirman Card and house allotment, they can submit their applications. Those approved will receive ₹1.6 lakh to assist in home ownership.

title: New York's pied-à-terre tax has homeowners trying to dodge it. Here's why
content: Homeowners in New York City received alerts about the implementation of a new pied-à-terre tax. This tax requires individuals to demonstrate that their properties serve as primary residences to sidestep the added charge. It specifically affects high-value homes not utilized as the owner's primary dwelling. In response, many homeowners are gathering necessary documentation and engaging experts to help with the exemption application process.

title: 'Job loss, financial stress': Pune family of 3 dies by 'suicide'; note found
content: A family of three in Pimpri allegedly attempted suicide by inhaling poisonous fumes. The father died at the scene, and his wife and daughter later succumbed to their injuries. Financial struggles and job loss were cited as reasons for the tragic incident. Police recovered a note detailing their severe financial crisis. Investigations are ongoing, and bodies have been sent for post-mortem.

title: Is there a genetic 'silver spoon'? What your genes can, and can't, tell you
content: Genetics play a pivotal role in determining the predisposition to certain diseases, but they don't seal our fate. Factors such as lifestyle choices and environmental context heavily impact our overall health and life paths. A recent study on twins underscores the strong correlation between genetics and intelligence, as well as socioeconomic achievement, prompting a reevaluation of how we perceive privilege.

title: 'In map of India, our North East is missing': Medallist Lovlina felt ‘hurt’ in Glasgow
content: Lovlina Borgohain said she felt hurt after noticing India’s Northeast was missing from a map at a Glasgow restaurant during a celebratory dinner. The Assam boxer raised the issue with management, who acknowledged the mistake and promised to correct it. BFI president Ajay Singh said there was no confrontation, describing the incident as an aberration.

title: ‘Culture of Congress leaders’: BJP minister slams Nana Patole feet-washing video
content: A video shows Nana Patole supporters washing his feet during Gurupurnima celebrations. Maharashtra revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule criticized this Congress party practice. Bawankule stated it is the culture of Congress leaders to indulge in such acts. He questioned why they engage in practices that only bring criticism. The incident has drawn attention and political criticism on social media.

The deceased's sister alleges foul play and disputes the suicide claim. Police have detained the wife and are investigating the circumstances thoroughly. The post-mortem report is awaited to determine the exact cause of death.

title: Bodies of Nirmal Purja, 9 climbers recovered after Broad Peak avalanche in PoK
content: Ten climbers, including Nirmal Purja, died in a Broad Peak avalanche. Search efforts continue for the remaining bodies after the incident. Rescuers recovered three bodies on Friday, facing weather disruptions. The Alpine Club of Pakistan confirmed the immeasurable loss to mountaineering. This tragedy highlights the extreme risks faced in high-altitude expeditions.

title: 'Love song and a murder': Video captures woman's final moments with ex-husband

He reportedly attacked her with a sharp weapon and buried her body. A goatherd heard screams and alerted villagers, leading to the arrest. The body was exhumed for a post-mortem examination.

title: New stock market timings from August 3: What has changed?
content: Starting August 3, Sebi will implement a new Closing Auction Session for F&O stocks. This session will determine the official closing price after regular trading concludes. Trading hours in the equity derivatives segment will also extend by ten minutes. The pre-open session has been revised with new order entry and matching times. These changes aim for a fairer and more transparent closing price discovery.

title: CJP offers legal aid to Noida teen booked over 'abusive' video on PM Modi

title: 'Mekedatu project permanent solution': Shivakumar on Cauvery water dispute

Shivakumar urged all stakeholders to move forward without further delays or wasting time.  This project aims to bring both states to the table for amicable discussions.  The Cauvery water dispute centers on sharing river waters during periods of low rainfall.

She requested stricter social media controls for minors and their exclusion from protests.

Stakeholders have decided it is not safe to push him back into cricket. A full recovery is now the primary focus for the Indian team. The two-Test series is scheduled to begin on August 15.

title: MHT CET 2026 CAP round 1 seat allotment result out today: Check steps to download

title: 'Buy police uniforms, head to Jantar Mantar': Inside 'Pakistan-linked' terror plot

Hamim was reportedly working under instructions from Pakistani handlers via social media.  Arpita is also suspected of involvement in a honey-trap network targeting influential people.  The investigation is ongoing, and more arrests are anticipated in the coming days.

title: Market recap: Top-10 firms add Rs 2.51 lakh crore; Bajaj Finance biggest winner
content: India's largest listed firms saw market value increase by Rs 2.51 lakh crore last week. Nine of the top ten most-valued companies experienced valuation gains on Dalal Street. Bajaj Finance led the surge after reporting strong June-quarter earnings, while Hindustan Unilever declined. The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty indices climbed significantly, reflecting positive market sentiment. Easing crude oil prices and renewed foreign investor buying boosted risk appetite.

title: 8 dead as heavy rain wreaks havoc, triggers landslides, floods across Kerala
content: Kerala faces severe rain and flooding, resulting in at least eight fatalities. Landslides and inundation have caused widespread damage across several districts. Rescue operations are underway for stranded residents and missing fishermen. Authorities have opened relief camps and issued alerts for continuing rainfall. Tourist destinations remain temporarily closed due to the ongoing adverse weather conditions.

title: RBI deposit rules: Differential rates, daily disclosures changes explained
content: The Reserve Bank of India has revised rules for bulk deposits, effective October 2026. Banks can now offer differential interest rates based on liquidity risk under the LCR framework. This move aligns deposit pricing with revised LCR guidelines for better asset-liability management. Mandatory daily public disclosure of bulk deposit rates will enhance transparency for customers. However, uniform rates will continue for similarly placed depositors across all branches.

title: 150-year-overdue library book returned in Australia; racks up Rs 16 lakh 'late fee'
content: A library received a book returned after 150 years overdue.  The calculated late fee reached approximately twenty-eight thousand Australian dollars.  This rare book was discovered during home renovations and was damaged.  It was borrowed by a local resident's great-great-grandfather in the 1870s.  The book will now join the library's local history collection.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.
